scope: n/l loanword follow-up: onset correspondence, source-specific lexical comparison and protection of xilan native material.

phonologicalEvidence.finding: Older Longshan and Xianren distinguish n/l; some younger Longshan speakers show variation associated with local Chinese. Palatal nasals occur before front-vowel/glide environments.

limits: The comparison key does not merge n/l in published spelling or source transcriptions.
The 仙娘 proposal follows source sense and syllable-by-syllable lexical analysis; no new donor-dialect recording or external dictionary reading is claimed.
